beats.say: This one lake holds more water than all five Great Lakes combined.
beats.title: ONE LAKE > ALL 5 GREAT LAKES

beats.say: Lake Baikal, in Siberia. It's long and thin, so on a map it looks small.
But it's the deepest lake on Earth, more than one point six kilometers down.
Baikal holds about twenty three thousand six hundred cubic kilometers of water. All five Great Lakes together, about twenty two thousand seven hundred.
That's roughly a fifth of all the unfrozen fresh water on the planet's surface.
It's also the oldest lake in the world, around twenty five million years old.
Small on the map, giant underneath. Follow for more.
beats.title: SMALL ON THE MAP. GIANT BELOW.
